# Timbre Descriptor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TimbreDescriptor`](gmeow-TimbreDescriptor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TimbreDescriptor>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A perceived timbre quality applied to a [`ToneEvent`](gmeow-ToneEvent.md) — bright, dark, breathy, gritty, hollow, etc. A value vocabulary of individuals; never subclassed ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Contested descriptors are coexisting standpoints, each in its own observation.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:TimbreDescriptor`](gmeow-TimbreDescriptor.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
